review.note: Dates widened under A7 from the article's own infobox and first sentence, "25–26 June 1950", against the item's single P585 of 26 June 1950. Place is the atlas's korea-strait (Q52052) and not a new record at the item's own P625: that P625 is 35.179N 129.076E, the water off Busan, and the article's own location field reads "off the coast of Busan, in the Korea Strait" — the strait is the thing the article names and the atlas already holds it.

title: Battle of Korea Strait
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Korea Strait", at revision 1376104466, opens: "The Battle of Korea Strait was a single ship action fought on the first day of the Korean War on 25–26 June 1950, between the navies of South Korea and North Korea. A North Korean troop transport carrying hundreds of soldiers attempted to land its invasion force near Busan but was encountered by the South Korean patrol ship ROKS Baekdusan and sunk." Wikidata item Q289102, whose own description reads "1950 naval battle of the Korean War". That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does.
